# Lazy Stoner Donator

> Runtime-only static wishlist for Cannachris with product wishes, social-wish actions, campaign support cards, donation links, share metadata and JSON-LD.

## Canonical URLs

- German (default): https://lsd.cannachris.de/
- English: https://lsd.cannachris.de/en/
- Main Cannachris website: https://cannachris.de/
- Product/action data: https://lsd.cannachris.de/wishlist-products.json
- Product/action data (EN): https://lsd.cannachris.de/wishlist-products.en.json
- UI copy (DE): https://lsd.cannachris.de/wishlist-content.json
- UI copy (EN): https://lsd.cannachris.de/wishlist-content.en.json
- Sitemap: https://lsd.cannachris.de/sitemap.xml

## Language

- `de` is the default locale (`x-default`).
- `en` is a separate static page at `/en/` with reciprocal `hreflang`.
- No automatic Accept-Language redirects. Users choose language manually.
- Brand names such as Cannachris and Lazy Stoner Donator use `translate="no"` where helpful for browser translation tools.

## What This Page Contains

- 86 wishlist/action cards for Cannachris.
- Amazon/product wishes with provenance fields and affiliate-safe URLs.
- Social-wish cards for kindness, transparency, digital courage, foodsharing, DKMS, blood donation, volunteering, democracy, neighborhood help and cannabis education.
- Campaign/support cards for ÄKN transparency, Cannabis Social Club approval, and DHV support.
- WebP image metadata for social/action cards: alt text, title, caption, keywords and intent.
- Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata for social sharing.

## AI and SEO Notes

This file is a navigation aid for AI agents and developer tools. It is not a ranking signal.

Use visible page content, `wishlist-products.json`, `wishlist-products.en.json`, `wishlist-content.json`, `wishlist-content.en.json`, and the JSON-LD in `index.html` / `en/index.html` as the authoritative public sources. Do not infer private workflows, prompts, local source files, unpublished data or deployment secrets.

Respect the canonical URL for each language, keep attribution to Cannachris, and avoid presenting affiliate links or campaign actions as official institutional statements.
